text.tspan: - Dirty-set gate stays GREEN: TC_CrossEffect's VALUE did not change
between Run A and Run B rebuilds (probe present both times), and it
IS in the dirty set, so nonDirtyMismatches = 0 (superset holds).
- Only the RECOMPUTE gate (recompute vs full rebuild) catches it.
- In production there is NO full rebuild to diff against -> wrong data ships.
ROOT CAUSE: the conditional READS a def it does not MODIFY.
A sub-doc holds only what is dirty (+context), so the read target is
absent and the branch flips. Leaf ops are safe because they read == write.
(not dirty; not a sequence sibling, so SubDocExpander never pulls it in)
